learningObjective: Distinguish ONNX as an interchange format from any specific runtime (ONNX Runtime, TensorRT importer) that consumes ONNX.

canonicalClaims.claim: ONNX is an open serialization format (protobuf-encoded graph over a versioned opset), not a runtime; performance is determined by whichever runtime imports and executes the ONNX file.
conditions: The comparison is between the interchange artifact and the execution engine.
The runtime supports the model's opset version and ops.
nonImplications: Does not imply full cross-runtime portability; op coverage varies.
Does not imply ONNX cannot be compiled AOT into another artifact.

misconceptions.claim: ONNX is itself a high-performance runtime.
misconceptions.whyWrong: ONNX is a format; ONNX Runtime is a separate execution engine.
ONNX is an open-governed project consumed by many vendors and runtimes.

misconceptions.claim: ONNX JIT-compiles to Triton at load time.
misconceptions.whyWrong: ONNX is a serialized graph; it does not embed a Triton compiler.

misconceptions.claim: Any ONNX file runs identically on every runtime.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Runtimes vary in op coverage and numerical implementations.
